task_description:
Use the right arm to pick up the marker and align it to the left arm to grasp the cap. Use the left arm to hold it, and use the right arm to remove the cap. Then use the right arm to write a line on the whiteboard. Finally, use the right arm to align the marker with the cap held by the left arm, to cap the marker, and place it into the cup.
Success condition: All actions completed in order, and the a line is written on the whiteboard, the marker is properly capped and inside the cup.
substages: 1. move right arm to marker
2. grasp marker
3. move marker and make sure cap is towards left arm
4. move left arm to the cap
5. grasp cap with left arm
6. right arm removes marker from cap
7. move marker tip to whiteboard
8. write line on whiteboard with marker
9. move marker back to cap
10. cap marker
11. left arm releases cap
12. right arm move capped marker above cup
13. release marker into cup
label: failure

task_description: Assemble the four pieces with a single arm: seat the red block and the green block side by side on the long yellow bar lying on the table, then cap them with the second long yellow bar. The bar used as the base is never lifted, and the other arm stays parked. Success condition: All actions completed in order, and the red and green blocks sit side by side on the long yellow base bar with the second long yellow bar capping them, joining all four pieces into one block.
substages: 1. move the arm to a loose small brick
2. grasp the small brick
3. move the small brick above the yellow base bar
4. release the small brick onto a free half of the base bar
5. repeat for the other small brick
6. move the arm to the remaining yellow bar
7. grasp the yellow bar
8. move the yellow bar above the two seated small bricks
9. release the yellow bar so it spans both bricks
10. press down on the assembled block to seat the layers
label: failure
